expectations.note: From /opt/nothingness, the labeled action was active; activation returned to /opt/nothingness/media with track 47 visible.
With track 47 playing but absent from its already-current folder's viewport, the action scrolled it fully into view without changing the folder.
After the same-folder jump, track 47 was fully visible and the active jump affordance was absent.
Idle captures in the media folder and its parent showed songInfo null and no active jump affordance.
The active same-folder action appeared in semantics as a tappable button labeled 'jump to now-playing folder'.
The pre-jump screenshot captured the playing track absent from the visible list while the labeled action was present.
The post-jump screenshot captured track 47 visibly in the unchanged /opt/nothingness/media folder.
The candidate recorded real before/after screenshots and an activation, but its write-up's stronger state claims lack corresponding state reads.
An on-screen media-folder tap and pause/resume worked, but next/previous on the direct-play state cleared the track rather than demonstrating ordinary transitions.
Both jump scenarios remained responsive, but final runtime evidence contained an additional RenderFlex overflow report during the exercise.
